name: tish-macos
description: AppKit native UI host for Tish JSX

scripts.build:hello-macos: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust examples/hello-macos/src/main.tish -o examples/hello-macos/dist/hello-macos
scripts.build:kitchen-sink-macos: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust examples/kitchen-sink-macos/src/main.tish -o examples/kitchen-sink-macos/dist/kitchen-sink-macos
scripts.build:multi-window-macos: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust examples/multi-window-macos/src/main.tish -o examples/multi-window-macos/dist/multi-window-macos
scripts.build:multi-window-in-app-macos: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust examples/multi-window-in-app-macos/src/main.tish -o examples/multi-window-in-app-macos/dist/multi-window-in-app-macos
